```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing XML-like markup <child>test</child> -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with entities &internal; and tags <foo></foo>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  %p1;
  <!ENTITY ref "EntityData">
]>
<?target data="processing instruction value"?>
<database xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment
       testing parser boundaries -->
  <record xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested>
      <sub attr="value">Some CDATA text &ref;</sub>
    ]]>
  </record>
</database>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent3 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Comment before section -->
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      <svg:svg width="100" height="100">
        <svg:circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40"/>
      </svg:svg>
    ]]>
    &ent2; &ent3;
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseText">
  <!ENTITY complex "&base; &base; &base;">
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY cover SYSTEM "cover.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level comment explaining the catalog -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload containing &complex; and unparsed entities.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>
    <xi:include href="included.xml"/>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task*)>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtddecl "<!ENTITY token 'TokenValue'>">
  %dtddecl;
  <!ENTITY external SYSTEM "external.txt">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment: checking CDATA alongside entity expansion -->
  <task>
    <![CDATA[
      Processing &token; inside CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </task>
  <task>&external;</task>
</project>

<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY eA "EntityA">
  <!ENTITY eB "&eA; EntityB">
  <!ENTITY eC "&eB; EntityC">
]>
<?xml-timestamp value="2023-10-01"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.com/meta">
  <!-- Nested comment with -- hyphens inside -- and text -->
  <meta:file id="f1">

    ]]>
  </meta:file>
  <file>&eC;</file>
</archive>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "Acme Corp">
  <!ENTITY % local-ent "<!ENTITY confidential 'RESTRICTED'>">
  %local-ent;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="print.css"?>
<note xmlns="http://www.w3schools.com" xmlns:note="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Confidential internal routing note -->
  <to>&company;</to>
  <from>Admin</from>
  <heading>&confidential;</heading>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Detailed body description with <tags> and &entities; unescaped.
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY defVal "DefaultSettingValue">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-app-version value="1.0.4"?>
<configuration xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/config/custom">
  <!-- Configuration parameters and CDATA tests -->
  <cfg:setting name="timeout">
    <![CDATA[
      <timeout-config>
        <value>&defVal;</value>
      </timeout-config>
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <setting>&defVal;</setting>
</configuration>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (chapter*)>
  <!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entX "X-Value">
  <!ENTITY entY "&entX; Y-Value">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY entZ '&entY; Z-Value'>">
  %pEnt;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="data" data="test-mode"?>
<document xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Chapter start comment -->
  <chapter>
    <![CDATA[
      Chapter body with CDATA section and entity reference &entZ;
    ]]>
  </chapter>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload*)>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY msg "Server Response OK">
  <!ENTITY % macroDefs "<!ENTITY extMacro 'MacroExpanded'>">
  %macroDefs;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug"?>
<response xmlns="http://api.example.com/v1" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <!-- Response wrapper containing CDATA and namespaces -->
  <soap:payload>
    <![CDATA[
      <data>
        Status: &msg;
        Macro: &extMacro;
      </data>
    ]]>
  </soap:payload>
  <payload>&msg;</payload>
</response>
```
